---
title: "Emotion Analysis"
---

```{r}
#| label: emotions-load
#| echo: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
if (!file.exists("data/processed/nrc_emotions_by_chapter.csv")) {
  source("R/02_sentiment_analysis.R")
}
emotions <- read_csv("data/processed/nrc_emotions_by_chapter.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

The emotion layer uses the NRC lexicon categories: anger, anticipation, disgust, fear, joy, sadness, surprise, trust, positive, and negative.

## Emotion counts by chapter

```{r}
#| echo: false
emotions %>%
  filter(!sentiment %in% c("positive", "negative")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(chapter_title, chapter), y = n, fill = sentiment)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Word matches", fill = "Emotion", title = "NRC emotion profile by chapter") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Dominant emotion per chapter

```{r}
#| echo: false
emotions %>%
  filter(!sentiment %in% c("positive", "negative")) %>%
  group_by(chapter, chapter_title) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(chapter, chapter_title, dominant_emotion = sentiment, count = n)
```
